title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than Never Conditioning: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
abstract: arXiv:2607.23191v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuned code LLMs are routinely conditioned on a design-intent specification, but the correctness axis of such a signal -- a wrong intent rather than an absent one -- has not been tested, and the benefit of conditioning is usually scored with the same detector that defines the signal. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, scoring adherence with executable geometric assertions that share no code with the header-defining extractor. On a pre-registered sample of 400 deduplicated held-out programs stratified over eleven intent profiles, at 40% prefix and three seeds, a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the never-header-trained baseline on 3/3 seeds under both tokenizations at the program level, and on 3/3 token and 2/3 text seeds at the 298 distinct model inputs they present. translated_title: 错误的设计意图比不进行条件设定更糟糕：CAD程序完成中头部条件设定的错乱控制诊断
translated_abstract: 摘要：微调后的代码大语言模型通常以设计意图规范为条件，但此类信号的正确性维度——即错误意图而非缺失意图——尚未得到测试，且条件设定的收益通常使用与定义信号相同的检测器来评分。我们研究了CADCON，这是一个在Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B的LoRA微调过程中，前置到CadQuery风格程序上的五特征设计意图头部，并通过与头部定义提取器无代码共享的可执行几何断言来评分符合性。在预注册的400个去重保留程序样本上，按十一个意图配置文件分层，在40%前缀和三个种子下，语义错误的头部在程序级别上，在两种分词下均使符合性低于未训练头部基线（3/3种子），并在其呈现的298个不同模型输入上，在3/3令牌和2/3文本种子中也是如此。错误头部的可执行性并未被抑制。
tldr: 本文发现，在CAD程序完成中，使用错误的设计意图头部进行条件设定，会比完全不使用条件设定更严重地降低程序符合性，揭示了错误意图信号的负面效应。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that conditioning with incorrect design-intent headers in CAD program completion degrades adherence more severely than no conditioning, highlighting the harmful effect of wrong intent signals.
